What was the reason of not using bound params for `batchInsert()`?

> What was the reason of not using bound params for batchInsert()?

looking at the code I asked myself the same question some days ago. I think it should use param binding.
first commit was https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/commit/a39638515fe67fd27087a8a14f1266cf4c535e17 as far as I see, @qiangxue do you remember the reason for this implementation?

The main reason for not using parameter binding is because batch insert could potentially insert many rows of data. I'm not sure if PHP could support that many parameters (in the order of 1000+), and if so what is the performance impact. We should do some basic test to check it.

issue.title: Error: QueryBuilder::batchInsert() while inserting boolean value in PostgreSQL

repository.name: yii2
repository.description: Yii 2: The Fast, Secure and Professional PHP Framework

issue.body:
According to manual
http://www.postgresql.org/docs/9.3/static/datatype-boolean.html
SQL query can't be executed because datatype mismatch.

> table(
>    field1 => integer
>    field2 => boolean
> )

For example:

> 'INSERT INTO table VALUES (48,1)' - wrong
> but
> 'INSERT INTO table VALUES (48,"1")' - can be executed
> 'INSERT INTO table VALUES (48,TRUE)' - can be executed

Quick fix:

yii\db\QueryBuilder lines 197-198

> } elseif ($value === false) {
>    $value = 0;

should be

> } elseif ($value === false) {
>    $value = '0';
> } elseif ($value === true) {
>    $value = '1';

I don't know what about other RDBMS. So it's need to find out.

issue.title: quoteValue don't escape backslash (SQL injection in batchInsert?)
issue.body:
Test code:

```
 $rows = [['id' => 1, 'name' => 'test\\'], ['id' => 2, 'name' => ':test'], ['id' => 3, 'name' => '?']];
 $command = Yii::$app->db->createCommand()->batchInsert(Groups::tableName(), ['id', 'name'], $rows);
 $command->execute();
```

Generated SQL: (notice that \ is unescaped).

```
INSERT INTO "groups" ("id", "name") VALUES (1, 'test\'), (2, ':test'), (3, '?')
```
